Сybersecurity
Without cybersecurity, digitalization is not possible. We are transforming the everyday for everyone through technology, and cybersecurity enables us to do so successfully. Get tailored cybersecurity solutions that meet industry-specific needs.
Robust cybersecurity
Empower your digital transformation
Your protection is paramount. A team of more than 1,300 cybersecurity experts works tirelessly to keep Siemens with its offerings cybersecure, so you can rely on us for your digital transformation. Maintaining and protecting our over 100 own factories positions us uniquely to offer both cybersecurity solutions as well as the practical know-how to make and keep your operations cybersecure.
In today's rapidly evolving industry, increased digitalization of Operational Technology (OT) has made cybersecurity more critical than ever. As we rely more on digital elements, the importance of robust cybersecurity measures cannot be overstated.
Together with our partner ecosystem at Siemens Xcelerator, we are dedicated to safeguarding your business and operations – we don’t compromise on cybersecurity and neither should you!
Cybersecurity is our priority
Trustworthy solutions
We prioritize cybersecurity in everything we do. In today’s digital world, robust cybersecurity is essential. By embedding cybersecurity into every aspect of our products, systems, and operations, you get comprehensive protection.
Cybersecurity-by-design
From concept to deployment, our solutions are built with cybersecurity as a foundation, ensuring that innovation is secure at every step.
Standards-driven
You get reliable products and solutions as we adhere to the latest industry standards, such as ISO 27001 and IEC 62443, and continuously test for vulnerabilities.
Cybersecurity offerings
We leverage our extensive experience protecting our own factories to develop cybersecurity solutions that offer proven, real-world protection. Our offerings cover protection, detection, defense, and recovery, backed by expert consulting to enhance cybersecurity and resilience for our customers.

Enhance your cybersecurity with solutions that have proven their effectiveness in real-world scenarios. Drawing from our extensive experience in securing our own factories and operations, we create dedicated tools, services and products to drive cybersecurity. We do not only provide cybersecurity services, but use them on our own.

EU Cyber Resilience Act: Fortify your cybersecurity
The Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) affects all companies offering products with digital elements (PDEs) in the EU, regardless of their location. Siemens is affected as well, and collaborating with customers, industry partners, and relevant stakeholders is key to addressing the CRA's challenges collectively.

Siemens Xcelerator
Today, you need to be able to respond rapidly to changes in your markets. Siemens Xcelerator will make it easier than ever before to navigate digital and sustainable transformation – faster and at scale. By combining the real and the digital worlds across operational and information technology, we empower you to boost productivity, competitiveness and scale up innovations.
Siemens Xcelerator
You deserve the highest level of protection. That’s why we have a holistic approach to cybersecurity. Because it is not just about protecting our own operations but also safeguarding our customers across industries and, by extension, society at large. Our strategy focuses not only on proactive protection, but also rapid detection, and swift, effective response to minimize potential risks.
There is no 100% cybersecurity, but there is 100% commitment to protecting as effectively as possible.
With cyber threats evolving rapidly and stakes growing higher, staying resilient is more critical than ever. Confronted with many cyberattack attempts each month, we understand just how challenging and crucial it is to maintain robust cybersecurity. While we acknowledge that no system can be 100% immune to cyberattacks, we continuously search for vulnerabilities.
Trust through transparency

Never settling: building a cybersecure future
We invest heavily in research and development to stay cyber resilient in the future. By securing emerging technologies like Edge Computing, Industrial AI, and the Industrial Metaverse, we ensure your operations remain protected against evolving threats, empowering you to embrace new possibilities confidently. For us, these innovations can only thrive if they operate within a cybersecure framework.
Collaboration and ecosystem partnerships
Siemens works closely with industry partners and experts to stay ahead of threats. We contribute to initiatives that focus on securing critical infrastructure, promoting best practices, and fostering innovation in cybersecurity. Some examples of our collaborations and joined initiatives.
Charter of Trust
The Charter of Trust is a non-profit alliance of leading global companies and organisations working across sectors to make the digital world of tomorrow a safer place. It was founded in 2018 at the Munich Security Conference to pool cybersecurity efforts, enhance collaboration, and foster digital trust in the face of an increasingly complex and severe cyber threat landscape.

WEF Centre for Cybersecurity
The WEF Centre for Cybersecurity provides an independent and impartial platform to reinforce the importance of cybersecurity as a strategic priority. It brings together leaders from business, government, academia, and civil society to develop solutions that enhance global cybersecurity resilience.
